ia-video-maker-free 1.0.0

- Initial release of IA Video Maker Free.
- Upload images or video clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB) and generate polished 1080p MP4 videos automatically in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes automated session setup with 100 free credits per user (no registration needed).
- Supports video editing workflows: batch, quick edits, iterative refinements, and custom overlays with music or text.
- Provides chat-based control for uploading, exporting, checking status, and reviewing credits.
- Designed for content creators and small business owners, with cloud GPU processing and no local installation required.
